sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid page sout2734 (reference list); TUCL DSpace REST search ('Yamphu' 106, 'Lohorung' 122, 'Yakkhaba' 13 hits); Language Commission of Nepal publications (grammar/research categories, site search 'याम्फु'); ELAR catalogue search 'Yamphu'; archive.org metadata search.
sources.note: No grammar, phonology or sketch of Southern Yamphu listed anywhere: Glottolog has 0 grammar/phonology/sketch refs (surveys, Hansson 1991, atlases, ISO CR only); TUCL yields only the three Yamphu M.Ed. theses above plus Lohorung kinship/grammatical-category theses; Language Commission 0 Yamphu items; ELAR only the Mewahang deposit; archive.org 0.

sources.citation: Hilty, Holly J. & Jessica R. Mitchell. 2014 [2012]. Yamphu: A Sociolinguistic Survey. SIL Electronic Survey Report 2014-007 (= Linguistic Survey of Nepal report, 2012). 193 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. No occurrence of stress/accent/tone anywhere in the text; Appendix C wordlists (Hedangna, Devitar, Rajarani, Pangma) carry no stress marks (0 primary-stress symbols). Secs 6.1-6.3 establish identity: Devitar (Matsyapokhari VDC) + Rajarani/Bhode/Manoboduk (Dhankuta) = Southern Yamphu [lrr], 89% lexically similar to each other, 76-79% to Hedangna Yamphu [ybi].

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2011. Change Request Number 2011-152: merge Yamphe [yma] into Southern Lorung [lrr], rename Southern Yamphu (effective 2012-02-03). SIL International. 5 pp.

sources.note: Nothing; identity document only (lexical similarity Yamphe~S.Lorung 83-86%, vs Yamphu [ybi] 64-67%; RTT 43%/58%).
